skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of phonetics and phonology, including phonemes, allophones, and phonological rules.
Analyze and describe the structure and rules of phonology in English.
Identify and analyze phonetic and phonological phenomena in English, such as stress, intonation, and sound changes.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and interpret phonetic and phonological data.
Work effectively in groups and individually to complete research and learning tasks.
Conduct independent research and self-study on phonetic and phonological topics.
Communicate effectively in English, applying phonetic and phonological knowledge.
